bug_info.bug_desc: The PMPCFG CSR write logic does not hardwire reserved bits 5 and 6 to zero, allowing software to set them. This violates the RISC-V privileged specification and causes a discrepancy with spike where these bits always read as zero.
bug_info.fix_hint: In the CSR write logic for PMPCFG0-3, mask out bits 5 and 6 of each 8-bit PMP configuration byte before writing to pmpcfg_d. This ensures reserved bits are always zero regardless of the written value.
